description: Meditation Boards Commission- Notice Calling for Nominations for the Appointments of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. The content involves calling for nominations for judicial dispute resolution positions (Chairman and Mediators of Mediation Boards) under the Mediation Boards Act, with specific eligibility criteria and appointment procedures outlined by the Mediation Boards Commission. This aligns with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with judicial appointments and dispute resolution mechanisms rather than general government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
